messages.subject: App greys out on load
parts:
When I run the shiny app in my locale browser all is well.  When I publish to Shinyio the app builds and starts successfully and after about 10 seconds the screen grays out (it appears that this is as the app is loading 35MB of data).  Then when I try run the app in from the URL the app comes up and after about 10 seconds the screen grays out (it appears that this is as the app is loading 35MB of data) like windows when a selection is not available.  All of the none data dependent functions of the app still work the only part that does not respond is the functions that are data dependent, I am baffled.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App greys out on load
parts:
Ben,
In looking at the memory consumption of your application,  is it possible that you are running out of memory?  The default instance size is 500MB, if you could try bumping up the instance size in the settings tab of that application and trying again it should hopefully resolve your issue.

Best,
Tareef
